summary: Iteration 44 — Tested new /api/attendance/all-stats + PATCH /api/business/attendance-config endpoints (RBAC + persistence + no-GPS check-in regression) and the new Pointage settings tab + Historique pointages (CSV/PDF export). Backend: 13/13 PASS. Frontend: Pointage settings tab renders (toggle + 5 role rows + save → toast), Historique page shows period selector (7/30/60/90), CSV button triggers download 'pointages-30j-2026-10-07.csv', PDF button triggers 'pointages-30j-2026-10-07.pdf', stats-table with all required columns, detail-{user_id} opens employee-detail panel. Rider login shows rider-punch-btn. However, TWO frontend issues found: (1) topbar-punch button does NOT disappear when admin disables attendance-enabled and saves — spec says it should hide for admin when global enabled=false. (2) In Pointage settings, the role-toggle checkboxes for 'rider' (Livreur) and 'stock_keeper' (Stock) render unchecked by default, even though seeded enabled_roles includes 'rider' (confirmed because rider-punch-btn is visible to rider user). Appears Settings UI is not loading enabled_roles state correctly for all roles (role-key mapping / state hydration mismatch).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='topbar-punch' remains visible for admin after attendanceCfg.enabled is toggled OFF and saved (toast 'Modifications enregistrées' shown, but button not hidden). Per spec, button should disappear when global enabled=false.

role-toggle-rider and role-toggle-stock_keeper render unchecked after loading /api/business, even though seeded enabled_roles contains 'rider' (verified rider sees rider-punch-btn). Likely a role-key mapping / initial-state hydration bug in PointageTab (possibly reading 'livreur'/'stock' instead of 'rider'/'stock_keeper', or local toggle state defaulting to false).

action_items: Fix ConsoleLayout/useBusinessConfig so topbar-punch is hidden when attendance_config.enabled === false (admin included).

Fix PointageTab initial state: hydrate role toggles from attendance_config.enabled_roles using exact backend keys ('rider','stock_keeper','manager','sales','community_manager'). Currently rider & stock_keeper toggles stay unchecked after load.
Minor: React hydration warning in console — '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (occurs on login page SearchSelect/select). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints are properly RBAC-protected: admin+manager can read /api/attendance/all-stats, sales/cm correctly 403. PATCH /api/business/attendance-config strict admin-only (manager also 403), persists through GET /api/business.
Settings PointageTab toggle state must mirror backend enabled_roles with matching role keys; verify PointageTab's role list uses the same identifiers used in RBAC ('rider','stock_keeper').
React hydration warning on login page (span inside option) should be fixed in whichever select renders option content as span.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (2 bugs — topbar visibility and role toggle hydration)

seed_data_creation: None (backend test restores attendance_config to all-5-roles enabled after PATCH test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints fully verified: GET /api/attendance/all-stats (admin/manager OK, sales/cm 403) across days=7/30/90 with proper row schema (user_id,name,role,worked_days,absences,late_count,late_min_total,avg_arrival,punctuality_pct). PATCH /api/business/attendance-config admin-only, persists via GET /api/business.attendance_config. check-in without GPS still works (200/409, not 422). Frontend Pointage settings tab + presence page selectors all present (data-testid='settings-tab-pointage','attendance-enabled','role-row-{role}','role-toggle-{role}','role-open/close/tol-{role}','pointage-save','period-days','export-csv','export-pdf','stats-table','detail-{user_id}','employee-detail'). CSV/PDF downloads confirmed working (pointages-30j-YYYY-MM-DD.csv/pdf). Rider sees rider-punch-btn. Two bugs to retest after fix: (1) topbar-punch should disappear when enabled=false; (2) role-toggle-rider & role-toggle-stock_keeper should be checked on load since enabled_roles includes them in seed.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (topbar-punch persists when enabled=false): likely ConsoleLayout grants admin an unconditional punch button, ignoring attendance_config.enabled. Should return null when !cfg?.enabled regardless of role. Bug 2 (rider/stock_keeper toggles unchecked): PointageTab likely initializes toggle state from enabled_roles but role identifiers used in UI loop ('rider','stock_keeper') do not match keys present in backend's enabled_roles array for those two roles, OR default useState([]) overrides fetched config before useEffect sync. Verify PointageTab's useEffect dependency on business config and that it maps backend keys exactly.
